construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit MP23-007 (Ministerial Permit, folder year 2023), status Approved, issue date 2025-03-19: "AB 2162 Ministerial Permit to allow demolition of three commercial buildings totaling approximately 15,520 square feet, and construction of a 6-story, mixed-use project consisting of a 100 percent affordable rental building consisting of 154 residential u" (city text cut off at 255 characters)
City of San Jose permit PRE23-166 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2023), status Complete: "SB330 Preliminary Application for a 6 story building with 154 units"

City planning records show earlier proposals on the site by Strangis Properties: PRE17-108 and PRE17-179 (2017, a 123-unit midrise), then PDC18-016 and PD19-011. The CEQA Notice of Determination describes up to 226 units in four to seven stories; the city permit PD19-011 describes up to 241 units in five to seven stories.
The CEQA Notice of Determination lists the APN as 271-14-152; county parcel data and city permits show 274-14-152.
Existing site: three commercial buildings built in 1958, about 15,520 sq ft (MP23-007).
